trust_docs_requested.account_type: WRS defined benefit retirement account (Beneficiary Designation ET-2320 / ET-2321)

subtrust_naming_format.detail: subtrust name first, then main trust and its date, trustee; unnamed subtrust by beneficiary or article; testamentary trust by "trust under article 'x' of my will"
subtrust_naming_format.quote: subtrust for the benefit of [insert name of beneficiary[s]] or subtrust under article 'x' of my [main trust name] trust ... Davis-Dogwood Children's Trust created under the Davis-Dogwood Revocable Trust dated 01/23/2020, Jane Smith, Trustee
subtrust_naming_format.account_type: WRS defined benefit retirement account (Beneficiary Designation ET-2320 / ET-2321)

ldps_or_descendants_allowed.detail: class of children or grandchildren only with this exact statement; otherwise name living persons individually
ldps_or_descendants_allowed.quote: "I also include as beneficiaries as if each were specifically and individually named herein, any and all of my natural and legally adopted children." ... You may substitute "grandchildren" for "children" in the above example.
ldps_or_descendants_allowed.account_type: WRS defined benefit retirement account (Beneficiary Designation ET-2320 / ET-2321)

banned_language.detail: no "or", no conditions on payment, no numbering, no margin notes, no fixed dollar amounts (percentages only); you cannot name someone else's testamentary trust
banned_language.quote: Do not use the word "or" when designating multiple beneficiaries. Do not impose any conditions on payment. Your designation will be rejected. ... Do not number your beneficiaries.
banned_language.account_type: WRS defined benefit retirement account (Beneficiary Designation ET-2320 / ET-2321)

custom_designation_accepted.detail: ETF form only, unaltered; extra beneficiaries on additional signed copies of the form
custom_designation_accepted.quote: Do not make any changes to the form. Your designation will be rejected. ... Do not write in the margins of the form.
custom_designation_accepted.account_type: WRS defined benefit retirement account (Beneficiary Designation ET-2320 / ET-2321)

custom_review_process.detail: every form reviewed; acceptance letter or letter explaining rejection
custom_review_process.quote: ETF staff review your form to determine whether it complies with ETF rules and Wisconsin laws. We will follow up with a confirmation letter if your beneficiary designation has been accepted.
custom_review_process.account_type: WRS defined benefit retirement account (Beneficiary Designation ET-2320 / ET-2321)

minors.detail: paid to guardian, natural guardian or UTMA; otherwise held until 18
minors.quote: You may name a minor child as a beneficiary. If the child is still a minor when you die, ETF will not pay the child directly. ETF will pay the child's court-appointed guardian, or the person providing for or caring for the child, such as the child's parent. ETF can also pay into a Uniform Transfer to Minors Account (UTMA) for the child.
minors.account_type: WRS defined benefit retirement account (Beneficiary Designation ET-2320 / ET-2321)

estate_allowed.detail: estate primary or secondary; no secondary if estate is primary
estate_allowed.quote: You may name your estate as either primary or secondary beneficiary by writing "Estate" under Name. If you name your estate as a primary beneficiary, you cannot name a secondary beneficiary.
estate_allowed.account_type: WRS defined benefit retirement account (Beneficiary Designation ET-2320 / ET-2321)

default_beneficiary.detail: standard sequence (Wis. Stat. 40.02(8)(a)), spouse or domestic partner, children (predeceased child's share to that child's children), parents, siblings (predeceased sibling's share to that sibling's children), estate; "standard sequence" may also be written in as the designation
default_beneficiary.quote: If you don't file a beneficiary designation with ETF, your benefits will be paid out in the order called "standard sequence" which is part of Wisconsin law. ... Group 1. Your surviving spouse or domestic partner. ... If there are no survivors in Groups 1 through 4, any death benefits will be paid to your estate.
default_beneficiary.account_type: WRS defined benefit retirement account (Beneficiary Designation ET-2320 / ET-2321)

successor_beneficiary.detail: a beneficiary (or alternate payee) may file a designation for an account received ("Beneficiary of:" box)
successor_beneficiary.quote: If you are receiving a death benefit from a WRS account, put the name of the person's account you are receiving. ... An alternate payee account plus one or more accounts as a beneficiary.
successor_beneficiary.account_type: WRS defined benefit retirement account (Beneficiary Designation ET-2320 / ET-2321)

lapse_rule.detail: predeceased beneficiary's share to surviving beneficiaries at the same level; with ET-2321, to the alternates named for that beneficiary; secondaries take only if all primaries (and alternates) predecease
lapse_rule.quote: If one of them has died before you, the other will get the full benefit. ... If a primary beneficiary dies before you, that share will be paid to any alternate primary beneficiaries you have named.
lapse_rule.account_type: WRS defined benefit retirement account (Beneficiary Designation ET-2320 / ET-2321)

divorce_revocation_stated.detail: divorce does not revoke; file a new form
divorce_revocation_stated.quote: Life changes such as marriage or divorce do not automatically change or revoke your beneficiaries that you have named on a beneficiary designation. ... To remove a former spouse as a beneficiary, you must file a new designation.
divorce_revocation_stated.account_type: WRS defined benefit retirement account (Beneficiary Designation ET-2320 / ET-2321)

max_beneficiaries.detail: 4 primary and 4 secondary lines on ET-2320; extra signed copies of the form allowed
max_beneficiaries.quote: If you need more space to name your beneficiaries, complete and submit extra beneficiary designation forms and clearly mark them as page 1 of 2, etc. You must sign and date each page.
max_beneficiaries.account_type: WRS defined benefit retirement account (Beneficiary Designation ET-2320 / ET-2321)

online_designation.detail: paper form only (mail or fax)
online_designation.quote: The only way to name beneficiaries for your WRS account or your Wisconsin Public Employers Life Insurance is by completing ETF's beneficiary designation forms. ... Submit your signed form to ETF via mail or fax
online_designation.account_type: WRS defined benefit retirement account (Beneficiary Designation ET-2320 / ET-2321)

submission_method.detail: mail; fax (not to the employer)
submission_method.quote: The form can be faxed, we do not have to have the original signed copy. ... Submit your signed form to ETF via mail or fax
submission_method.account_type: WRS defined benefit retirement account (Beneficiary Designation ET-2320 / ET-2321)
